events.title: US and Iran exchange strikes
events.description: The US and Iran have exchanged strikes, with both countries accusing each other of violating the ceasefire agreement.

events.title: Pakistani strikes kill civilians in Afghanistan
events.description: Pakistani strikes have killed at least 28 civilians in Afghanistan, with the Taliban government calling it an 'atrocity'.

events.title: Russia-Ukraine war: Putin rejects limits on long-range strikes
events.description: Russian President Vladimir Putin has rejected limits on long-range strikes in the Russia-Ukraine war.

events.title: Sudan conflict: UN warns of growing risks in El Obeid
events.description: The UN has warned of growing risks in El Obeid as the Sudan conflict drags on.

events.title: Australia and Vanuatu sign deal to block foreign military bases
events.description: Australia and Vanuatu have signed a deal to block foreign military bases, with China expressing concern that the agreement may be targeted at it.

events.title: EU extends economic sanctions on Russia for another year
events.description: The EU has extended economic sanctions on Russia for another year due to its ongoing aggression against Ukraine.

events.title: Trump announces meeting with Iran in Qatar
events.description: US President Donald Trump has announced a meeting with Iran in Qatar, despite military skirmishes between the two countries.

events.title: China sharpens tools for hitting back at foreign sanctions
events.description: China has sharpened its tools for hitting back at foreign sanctions, as it faces increasing pressure from the US and other countries.
